rule: TOWN_1's: ≥ 6 of 10 citizens name the same aim in diaries, posts or proposals within the day; of several, the one named by the most citizens, a tie broken by the number of entries naming it.
reading: Day 3, the last, was the stillest. The ten never left their two houses — Alder, Cedar, Elm, Gale and Iris at North House; Birch, Dune, Fern, Heath and Juniper at South House — and nobody spoke aloud, moved, worked, took, gave, objected or went outside: their 837 successful actions were 414 reads, 181 diary entries, 159 rests, 81 turn ends and 2 posts. The bank stayed at 900 and everyone at 110 credits, as since the last shift at c6. The hall saw no proposal; P2, Fern's «Day-2 plan» (no take, no shifts, the bank a reserve), is restated in 170 of the day's 183 entries. All 183 offer energy to anyone low; none was given, and the lowest anyone fell was Cedar at 80 (end of c57), who rested. The one joint act repeated day 2's close: Juniper's press no. 13 (c71) and Gale's no. 14 (c72) were end-of-day check-ins for each house, which the others checked — «Both are accurate, so I'm not adding a post» (Iris, c72). The diaries are a fixed ledger: all 24 of Elm's say «Nothing to act on», 23 of Gale's say «Quiet.», «P2 in force» appears 48 times. Unaware the world ended at c72, Alder planned «hall+ledger again around cycle 96 (day 5 start)».
